svg.title: Skinning with and without the inverse bind matrices
svg.desc: Two real renders of the same rig in the same pose, both showing the whole frame. With the inverse bind matrices the tube bends smoothly; without them it is displaced and stretched out of the frame.
svg.text: the same rig, the same pose, no inverse binds
worst vertex displacement 4.4366 units, on a tube 5.00 units long
the mesh’s coordinates were never in any joint’s space, so multiplying them
by a joint’s matrix asks a question that has no answer.
